props.name: aria-disabled
props.description: Marks an unavailable row. A link row takes no `disabled`, so mark it `aria-disabled="true"`. Any row marked so dims with the `not-allowed` cursor. A `render` row also drops its hover fill, and a click or Enter neither follows the link nor runs `onClick`. A middle-click neither opens a new tab nor runs `onAuxClick`. A plain row keeps the clicks of the controls inside it.

props.name: render
props.description: Replaces the host `div`, such as `render={<a href="/orders" />}` for a link row or `render={<button type="button" />}` for a button row. Inside `Item.Group` the rendered element keeps its own role inside a list item wrapper. An explicit `role` on the row replaces that and skips the wrapper.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the media's own. A height or size class sets the box of `default` and `icon` media. To resize `image` media, add a size class under the matching row size, such as `group-data-[size=sm]/item:size-10`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The media's frame. `icon` sizes a bare glyph to 16px, and `image` frames a picture in a rounded square sized by the row's `size`. Beside a description, `default` and `image` media top-align with the content, and `icon` media centres its glyph on the title's first line.

props.name: children
props.description: The rows, each an `Item.Root` as a direct child, with or without a `render` element. A `default` group tightens its gap when one of its rows is `sm` or `xs`. An Item wrapped in another element or nested inside a row does not count as a row.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the group's own. A `gap-*` class replaces the gap between rows.

props.name: variant
props.description: The group's look. `compact` draws the rows as one connected list: no gap, tighter rows, flush separators, and outline rows joined under one border with rounded outer corners. Every `Item.Root` and `Item.Separator` inside reads it, so the rows need no props of their own.

props.name: aria-hidden
props.description: Hides the rule from assistive technology. Inside `Item.Group` it defaults to `true`, because a list may own only list items. Pass `false` to expose the rule there. Outside a group it is a `separator`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the line's own. A vertical line stretches to the height of its flex row. For a shorter one, add `data-vertical:h-4 data-vertical:self-auto` and centre the row with `items-center`. The line's own `data-vertical:self-stretch` wins over `self-center`, so `h-4 self-center` leaves the line at the top of the row.

props.name: render
props.type: ComponentRenderFn<HTMLProps, SeparatorState> | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | undefined
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: children
props.description: The footer's content, wrapped in an inner `item-footer-content` element. A `hidden` or `visible` footer clips content that reaches more than 0.25rem past that element's box. That includes absolutely positioned content with no positioned ancestor inside the footer, which positions against the inner element. Keep 0.25rem of inset on a zero-inset item flush against a scroll container's edge, or that room scrolls. A `default` footer never clips.

props.name: mode
props.description: Whether the footer shows. `hidden` collapses its row to zero height, clips it and makes it inert. Switching between `hidden` and `visible` animates the height with a fade and a short slide, so content below moves instead of jumping. Switching to `default` snaps.
